description: String of pearls: Storm Intensity -> Storm-Gauge -> GEV Hazard -> PRS Pricing -> Delta Engine. Stress branch: Storm-Gauge -> Flood Classifier -> Delta Engine

links.compatibility: Continuous 0-1 score (or letter grade via band mid-point) to floor-uplift ramp

fields.name: BRIFloodScore
fields.description: Flood resilience sub-score in [0,1]; drives uplift(s) on the ramp [SCORE_LO, SCORE_HI] -> [0, MAX_M]

fields.name: BRIFloodRating
fields.description: Letter grade (AA/A/B/NR) used as a fallback for assets without a numeric flood score; mapped to a representative score via BRI_FLOOR_RATING_SCORES

links.data_handoff: BRI-adjusted effective floor level and resilient flood spread
links.compatibility: Raised flood threshold removes severe-flood events from the count, lowering the resilient PRS spread (resilient <= pure)

fields.name: BRIAdjustedFloorLevelMeters
fields.description: FloorLevelMeters + uplift(BRIFloodScore); compared against attenuated WSE in the PRS severe-flood filter

fields.name: spread_decomposition.bri_spread_bps
fields.description: PRS flood spread computed on the BRI-adjusted flood count (the 'resilient' variant)

fields.name: resilience_effect_bps
fields.description: pure_spread_bps - bri_spread_bps; the resilience credit, always >= 0
